About the Luxury SUV (Suburban)

A custom sound system with subwoofers, state-of-the-art comfort air-ride suspension, and limousine privacy.

The one for any point-to-point charter with a chauffeur: the airport, the dinner, the meeting, the show, the wedding, the day out. It is not just for airport and executive trips; it works for every event we can think of.

Seats: Heated and ventilated leather captain’s seats

Luxury SUV (Suburban) rental in Scottsdale, Phoenix and Paradise Valley: chauffeured by the hour from $125 with a 4-hour minimum, or as a one-way airport and event transfer from $225. Seats 6, room for 10 bags.

The Luxury SUV (Suburban) is the Chevrolet Suburban Premier on this listing: black-on-black, black wheels, heated and ventilated leather captain's seats, a custom sound system with subwoofers, comfort air-ride suspension, and limousine privacy. It is the chauffeured black-car SUV for a small group, the ride when an Executive Sprinter (up to 14) is more vehicle than the day needs.

The fleet listing seats 6 passengers with room for 10 bags. That covers a couple with luggage, a small meeting, the wedding couple or their parents, a golf foursome, or a Sky Harbor arrival of two to 6. Ordinary suitcases are what the bag phrase covers. Golf clubs, child seats, and other oversized pieces are confirmed with reservations before you book. Rates, tax, deposits, and minimums are not reprinted here. The booking card, the pricing page, and live checkout are the figures for your date. Call or text (623) 986-6339, or email reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com.

Who this SUV is for

Book the Luxury SUV (Suburban) when the group is 6 or fewer and the point of the ride is a private black car: airport, dinner, a meeting, a show, a wedding party car, or a golf day that fits the listing. It is not the shuttle for a group that has already outgrown 6 seats.

  • Airport transfers. Phoenix Sky Harbor for parties of up to 6 with typical luggage. The product rules live on Phoenix airport transportation. The drive between the airport and town is in the Phoenix airport to Scottsdale guide.
  • Corporate meetings. An executive pair, a visiting client, or a small staff group between a hotel and an office. corporate transportation is the service page. The Suburban is the unit when the headcount stays at 6 or below.
  • Dinner and a show. Hotel, restaurant, theater, and back, when everyone fits in one black car. Hourly service is the usual shape, because the chauffeur waits.
  • Wedding couple and parents. The getaway car, or the car for parents, when guests ride separately. Day-of order is on wedding transportation. The Suburban is not a guest shuttle.
  • Golf with clubs. A foursome can share the Suburban when the clubs are part of the request. Larger outings belong on golf outing transportation.
  • Paradise Valley hotel hops. Resort-to-resort and resort-to-dinner rides for a small party. Coverage is on the Paradise Valley page. Name the hotel or house when you book.
  • A chauffeur, not a self-drive rental. Every booking of this Luxury SUV (Suburban) is chauffeured. Scottsdale chauffeur service is the broader black-car service if you are still choosing the shape of the day.

Airport transfers in the Suburban

A one-way airport ride is a transfer, not an open-ended hourly charter. Airport pages describe a flat zone: inside a published road-mile radius the transfer is a flat figure, and past that radius the price follows the drive. The radius and the amount stay on those pages and in live checkout. Start with Phoenix airport transportation and the Phoenix airport to Scottsdale guide, then confirm the total in the booking card with the real addresses. A Scottsdale hotel and a Paradise Valley house are not the same ride.

Luggage is why a party of four to 6 often stays in the Suburban instead of a sedan. The listing's room for 10 bags is the planning number for ordinary bags. Oversized pieces, clubs, or a child seat need to be named so reservations can confirm fit. Have the flight number and a mobile number that works when you land. A larger party, or luggage past the published bag room, moves to an Executive Sprinter.

Hourly chauffeur vs one-way transfer

Book the Luxury SUV (Suburban) by the hour when the chauffeur should stay with you: a multi-stop night, dinner and a show, a wedding timeline, a meeting day with waiting, or a Paradise Valley evening that is three curbs. The hours cover driving and the waiting you listed. Book a one-way transfer when the job is a single ride, hotel to Sky Harbor or airport to a resort. A ride back later is a second transfer or a round trip, priced in checkout.

Minimums and tax are not copied onto this page. Read pricing and the FAQ, then treat checkout as the source of truth for your date. For the numbers in writing, include the date, both addresses, the passenger count, the bag note, and either the hours or the one-way pair. Send that to reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com, call or text (623) 986-6339, or use contact. If the Suburban is the wrong size, the fleet index is the comparison set.

Suburban vs Sprinter vs Maybach Jet

The choice is the group, the bags, and the cabin. Seat counts here for the Suburban and the Executive Sprinters are the figures already published for those units. The Maybach Jet Sprinter is the wow-cabin comparison only. Still deciding? Send the headcount and the bag list before you pay. Fit is confirmed in writing. (623) 986-6339 · reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com.

  • Up to 6 passengers, room for 10 bags, black-car feel. Stay with the Luxury SUV (Suburban): captain's seats, privacy, and a cabin for a small party. Choose it when a Sprinter would ride half empty and a sedan would not take the bags.
  • More than 6 passengers, up to 14, or luggage that outgrows the SUV. Move to the Executive Black Sprinter or the Executive White Sprinter. Both are the Executive Sprinter class at the same published seat count. The white page is written for weddings and formal settings; the black Sprinter is that class of cabin in black. Each page carries its own luggage note.
  • An ultra wow cabin, rather than a black-car SUV. Compare the Maybach Jet Sprinter when the interior is the reason for the booking. Seating, luggage, and rates for that unit live on its fleet page and in live checkout. This guide does not restate them. Use the Suburban when you want 6 quiet seats and bag room in a chauffeured SUV.

Frequently asked questions

How many people fit in your luxury SUV in Scottsdale?

The Luxury SUV (Suburban) seats up to 6 passengers with room for 10 bags on the current fleet listing. Confirm oversized items such as golf clubs and child seats with reservations before you book. Call or text (623) 986-6339 or email reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com.

Is a chauffeured Suburban better than a Sprinter for the airport?

For parties of up to 6 with typical luggage, the Suburban is often the right fit. Larger groups or very heavy luggage usually move to an Executive Sprinter. Compare Phoenix airport transportation and the Phoenix airport to Scottsdale guide, then confirm the total in live checkout.

Do you offer hourly chauffeur service in a luxury SUV?

Yes. The Luxury SUV (Suburban) is booked chauffeured by the hour or as a one-way transfer. Published figures, including any minimum and tax, appear at checkout and on the pricing page. For a written quote, include the date, pickup, destination, passenger count, and hours via contact, reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com, or (623) 986-6339.
